before.geom_type: mesh (MuJoCo collides a mesh geom as its convex hull)
before.obj: skypaw-rubble.obj: one object, 144 vertices (18 boxes x 8), world metres

after.geom_type: mesh (MuJoCo collides a mesh geom as its convex hull)
after.obj: skypaw-rubble-NN.obj: one box each, 8 vertices, world metres

conclusion: No recentring: geom pos 0, no refpos/refquat, vertices are world metres. Cyberwave flattened the 18-node GLB into ONE mesh geom, so MuJoCo collided the convex hull of the whole site; the Go2 front stopped on that hull boundary in both runs (within 1 cm). Fix: one asset + fixed twin per box -> 18 convex collision geoms.
